elements.element: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
elements.evidence: The clause retains the Monthly Base Fee and other minimum monthly fees and requires Customer to obtain all bundled Services during the current twelve-month period.

elements.element: Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services.
elements.evidence: Minimum monthly fees remain due in advance; the ordered-and-used limitation applies only to the true-up following a reduction.

elements.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
elements.evidence: Customer's obligation to obtain the bundled Services applies “during the then-current twelve (12) month period of the Term only.”

elements.element: Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: Customer may reduce the included Services and corresponding Monthly Base Fee commitment upon thirty days' prior written notice.

elements.element: Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.
elements.evidence: The clause states that any resulting shortfall is handled solely through a true-up to Services actually ordered and used, and not as a penalty.
